data.description:
## Context
The rebar-debug construct sweep for `fibrous-fabulous-dungbeetle` found a third live instance of the same centralization regression. `applier._load_concurrency()` executes `_concurrency.py` by file path under the non-package key `_concurrency`, but `snapshot_head()` unconditionally executes `from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter`. In a supported installed in-process environment, the top-level package is intentionally absent.

## Runtime Evidence
A fresh process with `find_spec("rebar_reconciler") is None` loaded `_concurrency.py` by file path, initialized a real temporary git repository, and called `snapshot_head(repo)`. It deterministically raised `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named rebar_reconciler` at `_concurrency.py:55`. `applier.py:268-278` is the production by-path loader.

## Plan
- Run rebar-debug independently to confirm legitimacy, loader identity requirements, and affected callers.
- Add a RED oracle through the real `applier._load_concurrency()` path.
- Restore standalone-safe git_adapter loading with the canonical dotted cache key, preserving package identity and snapshot semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A by-path-loaded concurrency module resolves the current snapshot from a real temporary git repository without package-path seeding.
- [ ] Package-context and standalone execution share one canonical git_adapter module object.
- [ ] Existing concurrency and applier suites pass.
data.title: Standalone concurrency loader cannot import git adapter
